SCHOOL EVENTS
No Registration Fees for School students
QUIZ COMPETITION
Fr. Ignatius Kandamkalam Memorial Ever-rolling Inter-School Quiz Competition
Guidelines & Rules:
Students studying in +2 / Higher Secondary who are interested in participating in
the competition should complete the registration by entering the required personal
details through the Google Form link available on the college website
[mgcollegepunnapra.ac.in].
The competition will be conducted in two stages. The first stage will be a 30-minute
written quiz on October 27 (Tuesday). Selected teams will then participate in the
final round, which will be held on the college campus.
Students participating in the quiz should reach the college campus by 9:30 AM.
Each team must consist of two members. Any number of teams can participate from
a school.
There will be no negative marking for wrong answers in the first-round written quiz.
The quiz-related instructions and communications will be sent to the registered
participants through the email address or mobile number provided during
registration. The top 10 teams securing the highest marks in the first round will
qualify for the final round.
The questions will be based on various topics, including Kerala history, arts and
culture, current affairs, science, mathematics, social science, and literature.
Certificates will be awarded to all participating students.
The First Prize will be 10,000, along with the ever-rolling trophy.
The Second Prize will be t6,000
The Third Prize will be €3,000
All questions and answers will be in Malayalam.
Students must arrive at the venue wearing their school uniform. They must carry
either a certificate/letter signed by the School Authority/Principal or their School ID
Card, which is mandatory.
Faculty Coordinator: Ms. Chithra Chandran (Mob: 9539844399)

--- Page Break ---

DISCOZA (GROUP DANCE COMPETITION)
Guidelines & Rules:
Each team must consist of a minimum of 5 participants and a maximum of 10
participants.
The performance must be between 5 and 7 minutes, including the entry and exit of the
participants.
• Participants must bring their performance music track in MP3 format.
Costumes must be decent, appropriate, and suitable for the competition.
• Vulgar gestures, inappropriate movements, or offensive content are strictly prohibited
and may result in disqualification.
Teams must report to the venue at least 30 minutes before their scheduled performance
time.
Medleys are allowed for the performance.
Any violation of the competition rules may result in mark deduction or disqualification,
depending on the severity of the violation.
The judge's decision will be final and binding. No further disputes or appeals will be
entertained.
Faculty Coordinator: Ms. Elizabeth Varghese (Mob: 9539844399)
Student Coordinator: Gopika S (Mob: 8921568689)

--- Page Break ---

HENNOVA (MEHENDI DESIGN)
Guidelines & Rules:
Participants should be prepared to create traditional, floral, or Arabic Mehendi designs.
Only one design will be assigned to participants by the organisers on the spot.
Participants must create the assigned design within the allotted time.
• Only natural mehendi should be used.
The design must be neat, creative, and appropriate for a college event.
• The design must be completed within 1 hour.
Mehendi will not be provided by the organisers. Participants must bring their own.
Ready-made stickers, stencils, or pre-drawn designs are not allowed.
Participants must create the design during the competition. Reference images are not
allowed.
Participants need to bring their own model.
Participants must report 15 minutes before the event.
Sharing information, outside assistance, cheating, or tampering with the competition
process will result in disqualification.
Any misconduct or failure to adhere to the rules and regulations will lead tothe
disqualification of the participant.
Decisions of the judges and event heads will be final.
Faculty Coordinator: Ms. Soumya V R (Mob: 9400434033)
Student Coordinator: Anugraha Biju (Mob: 7874489232)

--- Page Break ---

CYBER RUSH (ONLINE GAMING- E FOOTBALL)
Guidelines & Rules:
All matches will be conducted in a 1 vs 1 format.
All matches will follow a Knockout Format.
No registration fee is required.
• Participants must complete the registration process to participate in the tournament.
The use of any type of cards, including Player Cards and Manager Cards, is strictly
prohibited.
There is no limit on team strength.
The match settings and additional rules will be communicated to the participants after
successful registration.
All participants are expected to follow the rules and regulations throughout the
tournament.
The decisions of the organizing committee regarding the matches will be final.
Faculty Coordinator: Ms. Sreekutty S. Kumar (Mob: 8281860265)
Student Coordinator: Abhiram G. Raj (Mob: 9895386547)
